query: A traveler says: "I have in-person meetings all day Thursday in San Francisco and need to arrive in New York by 8:30 a.m. Friday. Please keep Thursday daytime free." Flight options include a Thursday 10:45 p.m. nonstop red-eye arriving at 7:05 a.m. Friday for $360, a Thursday 1:30 p.m. nonstop arriving Thursday night for $330, a Friday 6:00 a.m. one-stop arriving at 2:15 p.m. for $290, and a Wednesday 11:30 p.m. red-eye arriving Thursday morning for $355. Which recommendation best fits the traveler’s request?
